description: Capability modules of Clicalo.Domain and their allowed dependencies (blueprint §4.3). A module is the namespace Clicalo.Domain.<Module> and everything below it. A module may use any module it reaches through dependsOn (the relation is transitive), and the graph must stay acyclic. ModuleMatrixTests fails on any type outside a declared module and on any dependency edge the matrix does not allow.

modules.name: Primitives
modules.description: Ids, LangCode, LocalizedText, ValueList and IIdGenerator.

modules.name: Geometry
modules.description: Physical and logical rectangles, points and placement math.

modules.name: Messages
modules.description: Generated MessageKey and message arguments (data/i18n).

modules.name: Errors
modules.description: Error, Result<T> and recovery hints.
modules.deviation: §4.3 lists no dependency, but Error carries MessageKey and MessageArg (§6.1).

modules.name: Privacy
modules.description: Sensitive<T>, redaction kinds and the [Sensitive] contract.

modules.name: Timing
modules.description: Generated Timings constants and their value types (data/catalogs/timings.json, NFR-020).
modules.deviation: Not in §4.3: every time or count threshold lives in timings.json and is generated as constants (§13, NFR-020); the catalog generator emits them into Clicalo.Domain.Timing.

modules.name: Keys
modules.description: KeyId, KeyStroke, KeyChord, CanonicalChord and InjectionMode.

modules.name: Catalog
modules.description: Generated catalogs (keys, categories, icons, blocked combos, system commands).

modules.name: Library
modules.description: The Library aggregate: profiles, shortcuts, actions and SecretText.
modules.deviation: Errors added: Library operations return Result<Library> (§6.2). Timing added: WaitStep checks Timings.Macro.MacroWaitRange (invariant I6, §6.2).

modules.name: Settings
modules.description: Settings, SettingDescriptor and SettingsSchema.
modules.deviation: Messages added: SettingDescriptor carries its Label and Description keys (§6.3). Timing and Catalog added in the M2 integration: the defaults and ranges come from Timings.KeySafety, Timings.Ai and TouchPresets (D-21).

modules.name: ProfileResolution
modules.description: Which profile the panel shows for the foreground app (Auto/Fixed).

modules.name: Frequents
modules.description: Usage log, pins, hidden entries and the Frequents projection.

modules.name: Duplicates
modules.description: Repeated shortcuts detection and DuplicatePolicy.

modules.name: Search
modules.description: Panel search over the library and the catalogs.

modules.name: KeySafety
modules.description: Keyboard ledger rules and the key safety invariants.

modules.name: StickyModifiers
modules.description: Sticky modifier keys.

modules.name: Touch
modules.description: TouchFilter and GestureRecognizer (pure).
modules.deviation: Timing added: the gesture thresholds are Timings.Touch.* from timings.json (§7.8).

modules.name: PanelLayout
modules.description: Rows, bar capacity, pages and PanelGeometry.Place.

modules.name: VoiceNumbering
modules.description: Voice numbers of the visible controls.

modules.name: Icons
modules.description: Automatic icons for shortcuts and combos.

modules.name: Dimming
modules.description: DimPolicy (pure).
modules.deviation: Timing added: the dimming delay is Timings.Dimming.DimDelay (§6.4).

modules.name: Interaction
modules.description: InteractionState: NoticeQueue, CaptureState, TestModeState and InteractionReducer.

modules.name: Execution
modules.description: ActivationPolicy, planners per ActionKind and EngineReducer.
modules.deviation: Timing added: the delay between injected events is Timings.Injection.InterEventDelay (§7.7).

modules.name: Document
modules.description: UserDocument and its invariants, document slices and backup kinds.
modules.deviation: Not in §4.3: UserDocument aggregates Library, Frequents, Duplicates and Settings (§6.3), so no listed module can own it without a cycle.

modules.name: Commands
modules.description: IDocumentCommand, IDestructiveCommand, UndoIntent, DocumentChange, DomainContext and DomainEvent.
modules.deviation: Not in §4.3: §6.3 lists the command contracts with the document; they are a module of their own because DocumentChange carries UndoIntent and a command applies to UserDocument, and CLC0010 binds to Clicalo.Domain.Commands.IDestructiveCommand.

modules.name: Migration.V1
modules.description: Pure conversion of v1 profiles.json into the current model.
modules.deviation: Document added: V1Converter.Convert returns a UserDocument with its Frequents and DuplicatePolicy (§6.6, MIG-008).

modules.name: Templates
modules.description: Template model and its semantic validation (TemplateSchema).

modules.name: Sharing
modules.description: Shared profile packages.
